**Result:** All the claims are backed. There are no invented stats, superlatives, guarantees, testimonials, health or green claims, urgency tactics, or banned words.

**One problem:** the first sentence ("packed by hand in Bristol") and the second ("Every tin is packed by hand in Bristol") say the same thing back to back. On a hero, that wastes the most visible line and reads like a copy-paste slip. Under the rewrite rules, keep the sharper version and cut the other.

**Suggested fix:**

> Loose leaf tea, certified organic by the Soil Association and packed by hand in Bristol. Free UK delivery on orders over £25.

This keeps every claim, drops the repetition, and leads with the most useful facts.
